THIRD-PARTY NOTICES — TestOrchestrator

TestOrchestrator bundles the third-party components listed below. Licence
texts are shipped alongside this file in 3rdparty/licenses/ and are readable
in the application under "Third-party notices" (works fully offline).

Python runtime components (see requirements.txt for pinned versions):
  Flask, Flask-Login, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-Migrate, Flask-WTF, Werkzeug,
  Jinja2, itsdangerous, click, blinker, WTForms, MarkupSafe — BSD-3-Clause
  SQLAlchemy — MIT
  alembic, Mako — MIT
  argon2-cffi, argon2-cffi-bindings, cffi, pycparser — MIT
  typing_extensions — PSF
  waitress — ZPL-2.1-derived (see waitress-*-LICENSE.txt)

Public HTTPS/redirect frontend (in-process WSGI server):
  cheroot — BSD-3-Clause
  cryptography — Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause (dual-licensed, see files)

Orchestration stack (separate buildbot-venv; see 3rdparty/buildbot-wheels/
for the exact wheels and 3rdparty/CORRESPONDING-SOURCES.txt for the
corresponding-source offer and archive):
  buildbot, buildbot-worker, buildbot-www — GPL-2.0
  paramiko — LGPL-2.1-or-later
  twisted, autobahn, zope.interface, automat, incremental, hyperlink,
    constantly, txaio, msgpack, pyopenssl, idna, typing-extensions,
    packaging, six, ujson, cbor2 — MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause /
    ZPL-2.1 (see per-wheel licence files in 3rdparty/licenses/)
